utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Please be seated. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-03-66-A, the Prosecutor versus Fatmir Limaj, Haradin Bala, and Isak Musliu.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. We would now like the appearances of the parties. The Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. CAREY
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Kristina Carey appearing for the Prosecution. I'm joined today by our case manager, Ms. Lourdes Galicia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Limaj.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: If it please Your Honour, Karim Khan for the respondent, Fatmir Limaj.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Bala.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Good evening, Your Honour. Gregor Guy-Smith appearing on behalf of Mr. Bala, who is present in custody, and I'm assisted by Caroline Buisman, my legal assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Guy-Smith. Counsel for Mr. Musliu.

utterances.speaker: MR. POWLES
utterances.text: May it please Your Honour, Steven Powles for the respondent Isak Musliu.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Powles. Mr. Limaj and Mr. Musliu, who are not currently incarcerated, are not attending this Status Conference, and I have to ask their respective counsel to confirm that for the record. Mr. Khan.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, that is correct. I'm grateful.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: And Mr. Powles.

utterances.speaker: MR. POWLES
utterances.text: Your Honour, the same.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Bala, however, is present today, and I want to make sure that he can follow these proceedings. Mr. Bala, can you hear the proceedings in a language that you understand? THE APPELLANT BALA: [Interpretation] [No interpretation].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. You may be seated. This is a Status Conference called in accordance with Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Rule 65 bis (B) requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days of the last Status Conference to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. The last Status Conference in this case was held on 29 August 2006. As Mr. Bala is currently detained at the UN Detention Unit, I want to start by asking him whether there are any issues that he would like to raise at this time. Mr. Bala, would you please stand. Do you have any issues that you would like to raise? Do you have any concerns regarding your physical or mental well being? THE APPELLANT BALA: [Interpretation] [No interpretation].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: I did not get translation. Could I ask the interpreter kindly to repeat. I'm supposed to be on channel 4; correct? I'm sorry, is the registrar hearing interpretation? Well, we will ask the interpreters to shout. Channel 9? Okay. I will ask the interpreter again kindly to repeat. Thank you very much. You may be seated, Mr. Bala. Now, I would like to ask the counsel for Mr. Limaj and Mr. Musliu whether there are any issues that Mr. Limaj and Mr. Musliu would like to raise through counsel. First counsel for Mr. Limaj, Mr. Khan.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, very grateful for the opportunity. There are no issues to be raised on behalf of the respondent.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Powles.

utterances.speaker: MR. POWLES
utterances.text: Your Honour, similarly no issues to be raised on behalf of Mr. Musliu.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Currently the Appeals Chamber is in the process of reading through the briefs of both the Prosecution's appeal and Mr. Bala's appeal. The Appeals Chamber will schedule oral argument on the appeals as soon as possible. Before concluding this Status Conference, I want to ask counsel for the Prosecution and the Defence whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise at this time. The Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. CAREY
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. The Prosecution has nothing to raise at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Khan.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, none on behalf of Mr. Limaj. I'm grateful. Mr. Guy-Smith.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Not on behalf of Mr. Bala. Thank you very much, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Mr. Powles.

utterances.speaker: MR. POWLES
utterances.text: Likewise, nothing on behalf of Mr. Musliu. Thank you very much, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Before we adjourn, there is one last piece of business that I would like to take care of. In accordance with Rule 65 bis, we will need to have another Status Conference on or before April 4, 2007. Wednesday, March 21 would, I believe, be a good day for our next Status Conference. So I would like everybody to plan on having a Status Conference that day. In the next year, I will hopefully send out -- in the new year, sorry, I will hopefully send out an order confirming that the Status Conference will be held on that date. The order will also let everybody know the time of the conference and the courtroom in which it will be held. I thank the parties for their attendance today and call the proceedings to a close.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
